raw_segments.text: Ah, home of royalty, beloved halls and solemn shrines, and gods that front the morn.
Benign is erst, with sun-flushed aspect greet the king returning after many days.
For as from night flash out the beams of day, so out of darkness dons a light a king on
you, on Argus, Agamemnon comes, then hail and greet him well.
Such mead befits him whose right hand hewed down the towers of Troy with the great acts
of Zeus who righteth wrong, and smote the plain, smote down to nothingness each altar,
every shrine, and far and wide dyes from the whole lands face its offspring fair.
